nodes.title: Matrix mortality
nodes.summary: Nonempty zero products in a finite family of integer matrices, with dimension and generator count fixed.

nodes.title: Word-pair representation
nodes.summary: A three-dimensional matrix morphism that records two ternary words and detects their equality in one coefficient.

nodes.title: Fixed-boundary correspondence
nodes.summary: Four nonerasing word pairs recognize restricted tag halting when the terminal marker is fixed rather than selectable.

nodes.title: Paired scalar series
nodes.summary: Two data controls and one phase toggle realize the complete fixed-boundary zero language in four states.

nodes.title: Paired-role compression
nodes.summary: An agreement subspace identifies two phase copies and reduces four role actions to three controls.

nodes.title: Rank-one separator
nodes.summary: Adjoining one outer product turns a vanishing boundary coefficient into unrestricted matrix mortality.

nodes.title: Interface compression
nodes.summary: Transitions and factored cuts are mortal exactly when the transitions are mortal or one nonempty interface-bridge path vanishes.

nodes.title: Singular-return compression
nodes.summary: One transition and one singular cut reduce arbitrary physical products to products of the complete return family.

nodes.title: Shared-partial binary compiler
nodes.summary: A shared unfinished word channel compiles the four roles into two binary controls in six dimensions.

nodes.title: Prefix-transducer packing
nodes.summary: A synchronizing complete prefix code trades generator labels for decoder state while preserving unrestricted mortality.

nodes.title: Common-image restriction
nodes.summary: A decoder family is restricted to its common invariant image, with an appended-letter converse excluding new zero products.

nodes.title: Tilted separator
nodes.summary: An injective length-tilted ternary code changes the nonzero coefficients needed by the realization while preserving the complete zero language.

nodes.title: Nine-dimensional return realization
nodes.summary: Two length-three nilpotent chains, one length-two chain, and one eigenline realize three exceptional moments and a geometric tail.

nodes.title: Tilted-geometric rank floor
nodes.summary: A uniform nonsingular Hankel minor forces nine dimensions for every exact retuning in the present one-mode geometric-tail family.

nodes.title: Effective denominator clearing
nodes.summary: Independent nonzero generator scalings convert a rational family to integer matrices while preserving and reflecting every zero product.

nodes.title: Valuation guard
nodes.summary: A three-mode return family forces one legal wait by a p-adic valuation and sends every wrong wait into a permanent trap.

nodes.title: Valuation barriers
nodes.summary: Parity, Smith isolation, and a universal-boundary divisibility wall exclude broad mortal strata of the guarded return family.

nodes.title: Two-generator projective incidence
nodes.summary: Given two rational projectivities and two boundary rays, ask whether some control word sends the source ray onto the target hyperplane.

nodes.title: Shortcut-Collatz reachability
nodes.summary: Finite reachability of 1 under halving on even integers and (3n+1)/2 on odd integers.

nodes.title: Shortcut-Collatz incidence
nodes.summary: Two fixed Möbius transformations, with target-dependent boundary data and central scalings, recognize pointwise shortcut-Collatz reaches-one exactly.

nodes.title: Rank-two projective-incidence compiler
nodes.summary: Every generic two-generator projective-incidence instance compiles to two rational 3 × 3 matrices of rank exactly two, with mortality equivalent to incidence zero.

nodes.title: M₃(5) is undecidable
nodes.summary: Four fixed-boundary payload matrices and one repeated rank-one separator give five 3 × 3 integer matrices.

nodes.title: M₄(4) is undecidable
nodes.summary: Paired-role compression gives three 4 × 4 scalar controls; one rank-one separator converts their zero coefficient to mortality.

nodes.title: Z₆(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The shared-partial compiler preserves the paired coefficient under every binary word in dimension six.

nodes.title: R₇(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The scalar-to-corner transport converts the six-dimensional two-generator scalar theorem to a seven-dimensional corner theorem.

nodes.title: M₁₀(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: A complete binary prefix decoder followed by common-image restriction gives two 10 × 10 integer matrices.

nodes.title: M₉(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: A zero-language-equivalent separator and a nine-dimensional return realization give a primitive-recursive pair of integer matrices.

nodes.title: M₆(3) is undecidable
nodes.summary: Prefix-transducer packing transports the five-generator dimension-three theorem to three generators in dimension six.

nodes.title: M₁₂(2) is undecidable
nodes.summary: The binary form of prefix-transducer packing transports M₃(5) to two generators in dimension twelve.
